answer: Sybil resistance in AI agent economies is secured via a proof-of-stake mechanism. Each agent must lock a substantial amount of native tokens, establishing an economic ledge for identity validity. This stake serves as a stable jetty, anchoring verifiable identities against illicit duplication. An attacker faces the prohibitive cost of acquiring vast capital to create fake identities, constantly under the watchful eye of a swift falcon, ready to slash stakes for malicious activity.
